item.description:
## 🔄 User Disclosures (Retail User) – Create Custom Disclosure Flow

| **Step** | Request Name | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Generate Access Token | Obtain an access token using client or user credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 2 | Search for Institution Disclosure ID | (Optional) Use this step to find the disclosure ID if it is not already known. |
| 3 | Create Custom User Disclosure | Add a custom disclosure for a specified user. |

item.description:
## 🔄 User Disclosures (Business User) – Create Custom Disclosure Flow

| **Step** | Request Name | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Generate Access Token | Obtain an access token using client or user credentials to authorize API requests. |
| 2 | Search for Business Entity | (Optional) Use this step to locate the institution customer ID if it’s not already available. Retrieve business user details and match the memberNumber (TIN/EIN) to identify the corresponding institutionCustomerId. |
| 3 | Search for Institution Disclosure ID | (Optional) Use this step to find the disclosure ID if it is not already known. |
| 4 | Create Custom User Disclosure | Add a custom disclosure for a specified user. |
